journey.title: Record a source with no API on mobile
journey.purpose: An operator records a cash sale while standing up, using the same first-class manual-entry path without losing the account, basis, or resulting position.

steps.intent: Open the compact journal entry form and choose the book and account
Record the cash sale without horizontal scrolling or a desktop-only control
Confirm operator-asserted basis beside the new event
See the position update while its source basis remains visible
